supersedes: D3_coverage_rebuild_if_D2_passes in first_fit_root_cause_recovery_v1.json because the strict D2 gate failed
any plan to use one realized pair as deterministic state-level hard gold
any plan to expand candidate-match-only memory features
research_target: Estimate, before generation, the probability that adding one qualified component to an exact fixed background produces a materially better immediate support response under the frozen generator stack.
not_the_target: deterministic truth for every individual state
future arbitrary Bank or memory-schema generalization

data_design.reason_second_reviewer_not_repeated: D2 already measures the binary decision reliability on a fixed independent overlap. D3 preserves that measured limitation instead of starting another open-ended review cycle.
data_design.state_weighting: Every state has total training weight one. Repeated pairs refine the state soft target but do not multiply effective sample size.
data_design.D2_role: measurement qualification, noise characterization, and feature-direction diagnosis only

coverage.background_actions: For each component, balance the eight exact combinations of the other three component bits; four new users per background.
coverage.domain_shape: Balance ESConv-like bounded support states and longitudinal-like states without copying ESConv test or EvoEmo content.
candidate_strata: low versus higher injected token cost
candidate available versus deterministic hard-off control

RS.bank: same frozen Strategy Bank V4 and natural Top-1 stack
RS.hard_off: phatic, closing, explicit stop, high-stakes, or no eligible card

feature_contract.capacity_rule: feature count <= floor(32 independent development users / 5) = 6
feature_contract.candidate_state_match_score: Frozen natural lexical retrieval score produced by the same runtime retriever. BGE is not a primary feature or selection requirement.
feature_contract.candidate_grounding_or_nonredundancy_sco: A pre-outcome transparent score constructed only from belonged-to-current-user, strictly-prior, nonconflicting, not-already-visible, request-currentness, and source-specific eligibility checks. Any hard violation forces component off before the learned head.
forbidden: user, state, card, or memory ID
topic or template token that directly identifies the intended action

measurement_and_loss.state_target: Mean of observed Bernoulli pair outcomes for that state; one-pair states remain stochastic observations and are never called deterministic state gold.
measurement_and_loss.loss: State-equal-weighted binary cross-entropy with fractional soft targets plus L2 regularization.
measurement_and_loss.grouping: All fitting, OOF folds, uncertainty, and bootstrap resampling are grouped by user.
measurement_and_loss.risk: Quality benefit is modeled separately. Candidate hard-risk and grounding exclusions run before the learned head; residual interaction-and-grounding risks are reported atomically and never hidden in a composite reward.
measurement_and_loss.cost: If predicted benefit does not exceed the frozen threshold, turn the component off. Among otherwise admissible actions, deterministic incremental token budget and lower-cost tie breaking apply.

execution_order: implement and unit-test the exact grounding/nonredundancy feature and explicit background bits
build 32 content-disjoint synthetic longitudinal users and all 128 state contrasts without outcomes
run leakage, shortcut, subtype, background, domain-shape, and feature-capacity preflight
freeze 32 repeat states before response generation
generate 320 response calls on one frozen generator stack
complete one bounded 160-pair blind quality packet
fit four logistic heads once under grouped OOF
only passing heads receive a new user-disjoint internal confirmation and then frozen external evaluation
stop_rules: Do not generate D3 outcomes until all feature and data preflights pass.
Do not add BGE, Qwen, NLI, a larger model, or searched hyperparameters before the transparent primary is evaluated.
Do not add more D3 users after observing a failed head in this V1.5 recovery.
Do not lower promotion gates or reinterpret external outcomes to rescue a failed head.
Do not request more RAG card review as a response to a memory-head feature failure.
claim_if_successful: On the fixed V1.5 resource stack and measured support domains, a low-capacity auditable Step-1 PM learned above-baseline conditional component gates that improve the frozen quality-risk-cost policy under grouped internal confirmation and one-time external evaluation.
claim_if_failed: The V1.5 study establishes an auditable resource-effect measurement and routing framework, but does not establish learnable pre-generation gating for the failed component heads under the available small-sample features.
